evidence.title: Design.md Store — AI-Ready Design System Files

name: Design.md Store
summary: Library of 51+ free DESIGN.md design-system files (YAML tokens + usage rules) for AI coding assistants.
description: Each pack is a single DESIGN.md combining a YAML block of exact design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, border radius, component properties) with markdown prose explaining when to apply them, formatted to the open DESIGN.md spec published by Google Labs. Covers 51+ independent, unofficial design systems across fintech, retail, gaming, media and more; free with sign-in, with a Pro tier for premium files.
contains: each pack: YAML design tokens + markdown design rationale
covers products such as Stripe, Slack, Apple, IKEA, Notion and Coinbase (unofficial)
setup guides for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Google Stitch
